title: Stonehenge / built together

location.series: COLLINS / Figma / Nothing Great Is Made Alone case study
location.extent: Complete clip; PNG is midpoint poster

slide_intent: Show a construction becoming possible through combined actions because teamwork is easier to grasp as a sequence of contributions.
strategic_value: A familiar monument assembled with editing tools can make Figma’s product metaphor accessible without product knowledge.
demonstration: Named Neolithic contributors scale and move illustrated stones; the view expands to the stone circle before the campaign line and Figma mark appear.
practical_value: Turn the shared editing model into a simple visual story with a visible outcome.

content_islands.name: Stone construction
content_islands.spec: Show outlined stones on gray with long black shadows and selection handles.

content_islands.name: Contributor tools
content_islands.spec: Use colored role labels and pointers to manipulate individual stones.

content_islands.name: Resolution
content_islands.spec: Reveal the larger circle, then the campaign promise and logo.

reference_purposes.Expression: Cursor-driven stone assembly translates editing behavior into a historical illustration.
reference_purposes.Intent: The campaign narrative explicitly challenges the lone-genius account of how great things are made.
